title: Blues singers and Lizzie Miles
summary: Punch recalls two male singers and no women, and that Lizzie Miles was away.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: No. Did they have any blues singers here in the old days? No.

Willie Jackson. I don't know what that fellow's name, Snooki Scotty or something Scotty. Them was the only two singers. I knew what they were around here in them time. Snooki Scotty, huh? No, his name was Willie Jackson and Colin. Yes. He worked there, right down there, right there, right there where, Tom Allison used to be right down below Canals Street, right in the block there below Canals Street. That place there now, what do you call it? Big old- Woodworth. Woodworth there, no, yeah.
No, he used to work there for the, for the, for the, Tom Allison. There was a nightclub right there on that corner.
Yeah, there was Snooki Scotty or something like that.
Yeah, well I know who that is, I can't think of his name.
Yeah, they was buddies, yeah. Yeah.
I can't remember none, not in them times, way back there, I didn't remember no women singers.
Lizzie Miles, did you know her?
Well, that's, yeah, but that's Lizzie. She's gone, I guess. Yeah, she was gone.
I mean she was gone when you got here, huh?
Yeah, she's out of town, she wasn't around here then. I didn't know her until I came back here, you know. What about Ann? She went up the country a long time, didn't she?
